scope: Focused article-scope corrections for flagged administrative pages and obvious top-20 growth settlements; not an exhaustive audit of all 460 candidates.
policy: The Wikipedia column links only to an article about the settlement itself (city, town, or municipality). A broader administrative-area article is not accepted solely because its coordinates are nearby. Native-language Wikipedia articles are accepted. No guessed or search/disambiguation URLs.
